_calibration: `achieved` and `floor_pct` are NOT here. They live in reference.json because they are measurements, they require the pinned hardware, and a generation that shipped them as part of its frozen definition could never be calibrated without being reissued. Until they are filled in, every cell is `calibrated: false` and the scorer refuses to produce a receipt.
_ceilings_are_arithmetic: Every `ceiling_seconds` is `max(flops/peak, unavoidable_bytes/bandwidth)` computed from the model config and the device peak. It is a LOWER BOUND ON TIME, it is not reachable, and `peak_basis` says whether the peak behind it was measured on the part or taken from a specification. `unavoidable_bytes` excludes every intermediate on purpose: an intermediate is removable by fusion, and a ceiling that moved when a contributor fused would not be a ceiling.
_cells_note: A cell is (stage, shape, dtype) and is scored PER INVOCATION. The DiT cell runs 20 times per generation and the other two run once; that is carried in the weight, not folded into the cell, so a receipt says which stage moved.
_weights_note: Each implemented cell is weighted by its share of the pipeline's predicted wall time (invocations x ceiling). Published rather than implied. Equal weights would price a once-per-generation VAE decode the same as a DiT step that runs twenty times, which is not what a user of the runtime experiences.
_what_a_generation_is: Everything here is FROZEN for the lifetime of BG-1. A receipt stays attached to the generation that produced it, so if the meaning of the evaluation changes materially the answer is the next generation, never an edit here. The generation's SHA-256 is recorded in every receipt and `burnish receipt verify` refuses one whose generation has moved.

description: PixArt-Sigma at 1024px, 20 steps, CFG, on one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. Three implemented bf16 cells scored on latency, peak VRAM and output fidelity; two declared fp8/NVFP4 cells published for their ceilings.

held_out._rule: Every cell family is scored on its published shape AND on a held-out shape drawn from this list at evaluation time. A candidate whose gain appears on the published shape and vanishes on the held-out one is reported as SHAPE_OVERFIT and credits nothing. The held-out values live here in the open because hiding them would not help -- what makes the guard work is that the evaluator picks which one at run time, from the base commit, after the candidate is frozen.
held_out._what: Shapes that are scored but never published, so a kernel fast only on the benchmarked shape scores nothing.

model._guidance_scale_note: PINNED here rather than defaulted. It changes the latents, so it is part of the oracle, and it was previously a 4.5 default in three independent places -- the gate, the reference-latent generator and the runtime's own PipelineConfig. Three defaults that agree today are three defaults that can drift, and the symptom would be a correctness failure nobody could explain.
model._pin_note: The revision is pinned because the reference drifts between versions and it is the oracle for everything else. A moved revision is a changed oracle and therefore a new generation.

name: BG-1

objectives._note: End-to-end wall time for one generation. `lo` is the timeout: a run at or beyond it scores zero on this axis rather than being a slow point.

Peak device allocation. `lo` is the card, because a configuration that does not fit is the ABSENCE of an operating point and must not normalize into a small positive score that still contributes volume.

Distance from the pinned reference latents. `lo` is the correctness tolerance, so a change that stays inside the gate while measurably degrading shows up as a smaller number here rather than as an invisible pass. This is the axis that makes 'faster but worse' a move along the frontier instead of a win.

tolerance._basis_note: MEASURED, at fp32, 5x the worst drift this runtime shows against the fp32 reference over the frozen prompt set (rel L2 5.004e-4, max abs 6.539e-2). fp32 because that is where the end-to-end comparison has signal: in bf16 the reference reproduces ITSELF only to 0.37 relative L2, so the comparison measures the trajectory rather than the runtime. The dtype path is gated stage by stage instead, where a single stage has not had twenty steps to amplify anything. The 5x margin is a stated judgement, not a derivation.
tolerance._determinism_is_not_a_tolerance: The same build must reproduce ITSELF exactly or it cannot be a reference for anything. Only the comparison against the oracle has a tolerance.
tolerance.determinism_rule: byte-identical latents across replays of the same build

bf16_vs_bf16_oracle._what: This runtime against the reference, both bf16, end to end. Comparable to the reference's own 0.371 across dtypes -- which is why it is recorded and does not gate.

fp32_vs_fp32_oracle._what: This runtime in fp32 against the fp32 reference latents, same pinned noise. It is the evidence that the PIPELINE IS CORRECT: four stages that each agree to 1e-5 assemble into a generation that reproduces the reference to 5e-4.

reference_fp32_vs_reference_bf16._what: The reference against itself at two dtypes. No implementation difference at all. This is the cost of bf16 over twenty classifier-free-guided steps at 1024px, and it is the floor under any cross-dtype tolerance.

step_divergence_bf16._what: End-to-end bf16 divergence against the bf16 oracle by step count. It DECREASES with steps, which is the signature of the sampler's precision cliff at high sigma rather than of a defect: at the first step sigma is 157, so the x0 prediction is ~300 where the latent is ~1, and bf16 spacing there is ~2. issues/sampler-precision.md.

stage_tolerances_at_scored_dtype._margin: About 4x each measurement. The DiT's is looser because its disagreement grows with depth -- 0.005 at one block, 0.009 at four, 0.137 at twenty-eight -- so the threshold has to admit the full stack.
stage_tolerances_at_scored_dtype._what: Per-stage against the reference at the dtype the cells are scored in. These are the checks that cover the reduced-precision path, and they are sharp where the end-to-end comparison is not.
